labels.endpoint_window: Treatment began 2 h after infection and continued "for a period of 12 h". The percentage time denominator is NOT_FOUND. Mortality monitoring for 7 days is described, but mortality results are not provided.
labels.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE for individual reported exposure percentages, regimen information and study context. These are model-derived exposure summaries rather than concentration-time observations or measured efficacy responses. Requirement support is partial: the underlying concentrations are reported as inaccessible, the MIC value and percentage denominator are unspecified, and no individual survival or bacterial-burden outcomes are supplied. Published target labels remain source-reported targets and cannot determine primary-analysis starting values, bounds, priors or rankings.

Neutropenic rats infected i.p. with 1 × 10^7 CFU; from 2 h after infection the four groups received the regimens in the header s.c. "for a period of 12 h"; controls got sterile saline. 60 rats, 5 groups of 12 (male/female 50/50). Mortality was then monitored for 7 days.

findings.reason: MI014 remains DEFERRED, OPEN, needed_at pk: Support for individual PK variability. F0003:S3:T6 provides individual model-derived exposure percentages and describes sampling after the first and last doses, but A62 states that the underlying concentrations are in Supplementary Table S1 (not accessible). This does not establish a defensible individual PK variability model or separate interindividual variability from estimation uncertainty.
findings.needed_material: At PK work, assess authorized individual concentration records, subject-to-regimen mappings, sampling structure and reported variability definitions or model uncertainty. Record supported variability or the resulting limitation without manufacturing it from group summaries.

findings.reason: A61 describes separate treatment groups, while A63:A75 supplies one Subject column beside four regimen columns. Individual values are available, but globally unique animal identities and cross-regimen relationships are not established. Identical row numbers cannot establish that the same animal received different regimens.
findings.needed_material: Preserve the separate regimen scopes and printed Subject values; obtain source-supported animal mappings before any cross-regimen or longitudinal joins.

findings.reason: Headers B63:E63 provide dose amounts and intervals; A61 provides s.c. administration, treatment start and treatment duration. Dose chemical basis, explicit administration times, number of administrations and last-dose timing are NOT_FOUND. These components must not be calculated or completed from another study during labeling.
findings.needed_material: Retain the printed regimens and obtain source-supported dosing-event details and dose basis before work requiring complete dosing histories.

findings.reason: B63:E63 identify fT-based quantities and A62 identifies whole-blood sampling, but this item supplies neither directly measured free concentrations nor a defined fu or bound fraction. Binding method, scale, conditions, recovery and any blood-to-plasma bridge are NOT_FOUND. DRQ12 is not matched as an available binding input.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported free-exposure derivation or applicable binding evidence, retaining whole blood separately from plasma and documenting any required concentration-basis bridge.

findings.reason: Individual percentage values and MIC versus 4 × MIC threshold labels are available. Numeric strain-matched MIC, MIC units and method, the percentage denominator and its exact start/end origin, and the free-profile derivation are NOT_FOUND. The 12 h treatment period does not explicitly define the percentage denominator.
findings.needed_material: Matched strain MIC evidence, exact exposure-window definition, free-profile provenance and traceable links to the dosing histories before index analysis.

findings.reason: A61 supplies neutropenic infection context, inoculum, treatment timing and saline-control context; headers vary both dose amount and dosing interval. Infecting organism and strain, infection site, measured control responses and regimen-linked efficacy outcomes are NOT_FOUND. Mortality monitoring is described without outcome records. Whether the design separates candidate indices remains unassessed; survival cannot be relabeled as bacterial burden.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported organism, strain and infection-site definitions, endpoint-specific response and control records, and verified regimen-exposure-response mappings; retain index-ranking eligibility for downstream assessment.

findings.reason: B63:E63 contain published 40%fT > MIC, 100%fT > MIC and 100%fT > 4 × MIC regimen target labels. They identify source-reported targets, but do not establish new project targets or permissible origins for primary starting values, bounds, priors or rankings.
findings.needed_material: Preserve these published target labels with their source and maintain independently documented origins for primary-analysis choices.
